notes.title: We’re excited to announce the release date for Mr.Billion — July 31st!
notes.notes: [p]We’re excited to announce the release date for Mr.Billion — the game launches on July 31st![/p][p][/p][p]The demo version of Mr.Billion received a ton of valuable feedback from players — and we’re incredibly grateful for it. You told us what worked, what didn’t, and what could be improved. And we listened.[/p][p][/p][p]We’ve fixed bugs, rebalanced the gameplay, and added new features — all based on your input. Now we’re ready to take the next big step.[/p][p][/p][p]🎉 Mr.Billion releases on July 31st![/p][p]Mark your calendars and get ready to build your way to billions.[/p][p][/p][p]🛒 Don’t forget to add it to your wishlist:[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3607490/Mr_Billion_Idle_Rich_Tycoon"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]
